description: Maintain bounded value-domain multisets in sparse segment trees with destructive merge and range split.

source.title: Segment Tree Merge and Split
source.algorithm_attribution: Sparse segment-tree merge, interval split, point update, range query, and kth descent; clean-room bounded profile.

contract.operation: Maintain a collection of sparse segment-tree multisets over [1,64], supporting insertion, destructive merge, interval extraction, range counts, and 1-based kth queries.
contract.root_semantics: Root 0 starts empty. Every split appends a fresh root ID; merge empties its source root without deleting the ID.
contract.merge_semantics: Merge combines multiplicities pointwise, reuses a nonempty subtree when the other subtree is empty, and consumes the source root.
contract.split_semantics: A split moves all values in the inclusive range [left,right] to the next root ID and leaves values outside the range in the source root.
contract.output_semantics: Each opcode 3 or 4 emits one signed 64-bit answer in operation order; absent kth answers are -1.
contract.error_precedence: Validate and process the complete input trace before output pointer or capacity checks; error calls write no bytes.

operations.0 root value count: insert count copies of value into an existing root; value is 1..64 and count is 1..10
operations.1 root left right: extract the inclusive value interval to the next root ID
operations.2 destination source 0: destructively merge distinct existing roots and empty source
operations.4 root k 0: query the 1-based kth value, or -1 when k exceeds the root size

input.root_id_range: Existing roots only; at most one new root is created by each split.

output.encoding: One signed 64-bit value per range-count or kth query, in operation order.

workspace.meaning: Output staging buffer for at most 32 signed 64-bit query answers.
workspace.operation_buffer_meaning: Parsed operation records: 32 records of four signed 64-bit words each.
workspace.internal_node_pool_meaning: 1024 sparse nodes at 16 bytes each plus 33 root IDs.
workspace.declared_fixed_array_meaning: The node/root pool, parsed operation buffer, and output staging buffer; scalar locals are excluded.

complexity.range_split: O(log V) for the fixed contiguous interval, allocating only partial-overlap boundary nodes
complexity.merge: Visits overlapping nonempty nodes and reuses a nonempty subtree when its partner is empty; total destructive merge work is charged to visited nodes.
complexity.space: O(Q log V) sparse nodes for the bounded insertion/split trace; fixed arena capacity is 1024 nodes.

oracle_method: Primary: sparse segment-tree insertion, destructive node-wise merge, and boundary-path split. Independent: one fixed 64-bin count array per root with direct slicing, summation, and linear kth scan.
